description: Build script for Android app release, handling versioning, bundling, signing, and checksum verification.

methods.name: formatVersionName
methods.description: Formats a date into a version name string (YYYY.M.D).

methods.name: formatVersionCodePrefix
methods.description: Formats a date into a version code prefix string (YYYYMMDD).

methods.name: parseVersionMatches
methods.description: Extracts versionCode and versionName from build.gradle text.

methods.name: resolveNextVersionCode
methods.description: Calculates the next Android versionCode based on current code and today's date prefix.

methods.name: resolveNextVersion
methods.description: Determines the next versionName and versionCode based on build.gradle content and current date.

methods.name: updateBuildGradleVersions
methods.description: Updates build.gradle text with new versionCode and versionName.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a file at given path.

methods.name: verifyBundleSignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a bundle file using jarsigner.

methods.name: copyBundle
methods.description: Copies a bundle file from source to destination path.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating version bump, build, signing, and checksum verification.
